name: Slime
lore: A wobbling heap of cave goo that drifts toward anything warm. Its hits are sticky and can slow a golem down.
weakness: Slimes are very slow (5 ticks a step) and only see 3 tiles. Walk around them, or hit first: they die in two or three blows.

name: Skeleton
lore: An old miner who never went home. It chases on sight and keeps walking to where it last saw you.
weakness: Skeletons remember where they last saw a golem, not where it is now. Duck around a corner and they walk to the old spot. Arcane bolts hurt them extra.

name: Cave Bat
lore: Fast, twitchy and mostly harmless on its own. It flutters about at random even when it's hunting.
weakness: Bats only bite half the time they could. Don't chase them: wait for one to land next to you and attack().

name: Fire Beetle
lore: A glowing beetle with a shell hot enough to light a pipe. Every bite sets a golem burning.
weakness: Its armor soaks small hits. Burning keeps hurting after the fight, so an on hurt handler that heals or retreats pays off here.

name: Cave Troll
lore: Huge, slow and very sure of itself. A troll's swing can stun a golem where it stands.
weakness: Trolls wind up for 3 ticks before a swing: when enemy.intent == Intent.Attack, step out of reach and come back.

name: Cave Spider
lore: It bites, backs off, and comes back. The venom makes golem joints stiff and slow.
weakness: After every bite a spider flees for two steps (its intent shows Flee). Don't chase it: wait() where you are and hit it when it comes back.

name: Mimic
lore: It looks exactly like a treasure chest, right up until it bites. Mimics never move.
weakness: nearest_chest() never lists a mimic, but nearest_enemy() does. A mimic only bites what stands next to it, so a golem can walk around it, or fight it at full HP for a big purse.

name: Will-o'-Wisp
lore: A drifting blue light, bright with essence. It flees from anything that comes near.
weakness: Wisps run away from the nearest golem. Two golems coming from two sides, or a corridor with a dead end, leaves it nowhere to go. bolt() hits it from afar.
